Title: The Outer Crypts
Theme: Damp walls and crumbling bones litter the cold floor.
TransitionStory:
You leave the outer crypts behind. A rusted gate grinds open ahead,
revealing slick stone tunnels where moisture drips like clockwork.

Title: The Damp Passages
Theme: Strange dripping sounds echo around you in the dark.
TransitionStory:
You descend a steep, broken staircase into a cavernous sunken hall.
The smell of stagnant water and old magic fills your lungs.

Title: The Sunken Halls
Theme: Pools of dark water reflect your trembling torchlight.
TransitionStory:
The stone walls turn smooth and black, hewn by ancient, non-human hands.
You hear heavy, rhythmic breathing echoing from the abyss ahead.

Title: The Deep Depths
Theme: The air grows thick, heavy, and sulfurous.
TransitionStory:
You stand before massive obsidian doors carved with runes of dread.
You push them open. The final confrontation awaits.

Title: The Dungeon Lord's Lair
Theme: The dark heart of the dungeon. There is no turning back.
